## Summary

The metering sweep (`Ec2InstanceDataGathererService.gatherUsage`) previously assigned uptime purely by the `meteringCustomerId` tag on each instance, dropping any untagged machine. This ignored the actual ownership rules and prevented Finance from reconciling uptime.

### Changes made

**1. `src/utils/aws/s3.ts`** — Added `listDocumentKeys(bucket, prefix)` to enumerate the per-customer onboarding records (with pagination).

**2. `src/onboarding/entities/meteringAccounts.entity.ts`** — Added:
- `CustomerAccountAssociation` (accountId + optional `dedicated` flag)
- `CustomerRecord` (the per-customer onboarding record identifying a billable customer and its accounts)
- `MeteringRegistry.loadCustomerRecords(...)` to load all customer records under `customerRecordPrefix`
